name: cited
description: Cited: a cited-answer AI research assistant. Streamed answers with clickable citations from live web search and your own documents.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cited/contract && concurrently -k -n agent,worker,gateway,web -c magenta,yellow,cyan,green "npm:dev:agent" "npm:worker" "npm:dev:gateway" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cited/contract && npm run build -w @cited/agent && npm run build -w @cited/gateway && npm run build -w @cited/web
